codeReview.summary: The feature delivers the requested UI surfaces (policy editor, graph preview, why drawer, run comparison) with focused Playwright coverage, but there is a blocking correctness issue in delegation-mode handling against real config values.

issues.description: `parseDelegationMode` only accepts `suggest_only|approve_plan|auto_trusted|full_autonomous` and falls back to `suggest_only` for any other persisted value. The backend still supports and defaults to legacy valid modes (e.g. `tool_gated` in `internal/config/config.go:348`, plus `prompt_only|tool_gated|auto_execute` in `isValidDelegationMode` at `internal/config/config.go:940`). This causes the editor to misrepresent current config and can silently overwrite a valid existing mode on save.

summary: Reviewed handoff, transcript skeleton, and commit 9767d0a. UI implementation is largely aligned with the feature contract, but the mode parser/selector does not preserve all backend-valid delegation modes, so this review fails pending a compatibility-safe fix.
